stem: Select TWO actions that support this requirement: Determining cost-effective AWS database services with appropriate use cases (for example, DynamoDB compared with Amazon RDS, serverless)

choices.text: Skip teardown if the instance is stopped
Use root credentials for every lab step
Design against the stated requirement and document tradeoffs
Validate with official documentation before applying
Store AWS access keys in the workbook git repo

rationale: A and B are sound exam/lab practice. C/D/E violate credential, teardown, or root-user rules.
